# Disagreement Log — Gospel of Thomas, Saying 51

**Date:** 2026-03-17
**Saying:** GTH 051
**Total Disagreements:** 2

---

## Disagreement 1 — "repose of the dead" vs. "when will the dead find rest"

**Verse:** v.1
**LOGOS:** "the repose of the dead"
**PNEUMA:** "when will the dead find rest"
**Issue:** PNEUMA converts the nominal phrase into a question. The Coptic has a noun (*mton*). Preserving the nominal form maintains the connection to Saying 50's "movement and repose."
**Resolution (SOPHIA):** "The repose of the dead" retained.

---

## Disagreement 2 — "do not recognize it" vs. "don't see it"

**Verse:** v.2
**LOGOS:** "do not recognize it"
**PNEUMA:** "don't see it"
**Issue:** *Soune* = to know/recognize; not merely visual perception. The failure is one of recognition (cognitive-spiritual), not sight.
**Resolution (SOPHIA):** "Do not recognize it" retained.

---
